finance-hq.seo_title: Finance HQ — Notion Budget & Finance Tracker | Templyworks
finance-hq.seo_desc: Notion budget planner: track transactions, monthly budgets, bills, savings goals and net worth in one calm page. Any currency. Works on free Notion.
finance-hq.intro: See where every dollar goes — without a spreadsheet. Finance HQ puts your spending, budgets, bills, savings goals and net worth on one calm Notion page, and does the maths for you.
bullets: LOG IN 10 SECONDS
Add income or an expense with a date, category and amount. This month's totals for money in and money out update by themselves.
BUDGETS THAT TRACK THEMSELVES
Set a monthly limit per category once. Spent, remaining, used % and status (Healthy / Watch / Over) update live and reset every month.
NET WORTH IN ONE NUMBER
List your accounts, savings and debts. Credit cards and loans count as debt automatically, and your net worth adds itself up.
NO SURPRISE BILLS
Every subscription and bill in one list. Yearly plans are shown as a monthly cost, and you see what renews in the next 30 days.
SAVINGS GOALS
Emergency fund, tax reserve, that trip — set a target and watch the progress %.
ANY CURRENCY, FREE NOTION
Amounts are plain numbers, so it works with dollars, euros, pounds or anything else. Runs fully on Notion's free plan; optional bonus charts for paid plans.
desc: Most budget apps want your bank login. Most spreadsheets break the first time you add a row. Finance HQ is the calm middle: a private Notion page you fill in yourself, with the formulas already done.

The page opens with an At a glance row — net worth, bills coming up and a budget check — so one look tells you how you're doing. Below sit your Transactions, Budgets, Goals, Accounts and Subscriptions, all linked together.
Built for freelancers, young professionals and anyone who wants to understand their money in 2 minutes a week.
included: Transactions tracker (this month, all, income, expenses views)
Subscriptions & bills with next payment dates
Bonus charts & visual dashboard (paid Notion plans)
Example data so you see how it works

No. Everything works on the free plan; only the optional bonus charts need a paid Notion plan.

No. You stay in control and add transactions yourself — it takes about 10 seconds each. Nothing is shared with anyone.

Product description

Assignments in one app, grades in another, exam dates on a sticky note. Student OS puts your whole school year in one place and does the grade math for you.

Routine: check This week every morning, add assignments the day you get them, and log a grade the day it comes back. Ten minutes on Sunday plans the week.

Built for high school and college students who want structure without building a system from scratch.

Yes. The grade scale is editable, so you can switch to your own system (points, 1–6, 1–15, percentages and so on).

Do I need a paid Notion plan?
No. Everything works on Notion's free plan.

How do I get it?
Right after checkout you get a link. Open it, click Duplicate, and the template is in your own Notion workspace.

Can I change it?
Yes. Every page, database and property is fully editable.
